key_insight: RECONTEXT improves long-context reasoning by recursively replaying query-relevant evidence from the original context before final answer generation, without training or pruning.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical, drop-in inference strategy for making long-context LLMs use existing evidence more effectively in real applications.
method: Build a query-conditioned evidence pool using model-internal relevance signals.
Replay the selected evidence before generating the final answer while keeping the full context intact.
Repeat selection recursively to separate evidence organization from answer synthesis, with no external memory or fine-tuning.
evidence_signal: On eight long-context benchmarks at 128K context length, RECONTEXT improved evidence utilization across Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and Llama3-8B and achieved the best average rank on all three backbones.
watch_item: Because it relies on internal relevance signals, performance may depend on the base model’s attention quality and add inference overhead from recursive evidence selection.
paper_title: ReContext: Recursive Evidence Replay as LLM Harness for Long-Context Reasoning
